text:
Jules: Hey all, day 2 here — quick map question. If I hit issues with badge, VPN, laptop imaging, repo access, or want to opt in/out of onboarding bots, where do I post each? Trying not to spam channels :grimacing:
IT Support: Welcome! short answers: badge -> #people-ops, VPN or network access -> #help (include 'vpn' in the message), laptop/hardware -> #eng-infra (include model & serial), repo access -> fill the Access form and ping @devex if it stalls. Urgent? DM me.
Priya: For onboarding PR/review questions, use your team channel first (e.g., #eng-runtime). Cross-team architecture or policy -> #eng. For long threads, start a thread and drop a short summary at top.
Jules: Nice. And bots — I got a bunch of DMs from an onboarding bot. How do I control that?
OnboardBot: You can manage onboarding messages with these commands: `/onboard subscribe` to get the weekly digest, `/onboard unsubscribe` to stop DMs. Click the "Get started" button in the welcome DM to set preferences.
Marta: Channel etiquette quick tip: avoid @here/@channel unless it's urgent. Use reactions for ack, and thread replies instead of separate top-level messages. If you need an immediate eyes-on, say "urgent" and tag the person instead of the whole channel.
Sam G: For scans/logs, paste into a code block and include steps to reproduce. Example: ```steps: rebooted, tried x, error: permission denied``` -> post in #eng-infra and tag @eng-infra oncall.
Alex (People Ops): For badge pickup we need: full name, office location, start date, and badge type in #people-ops. We usually process within 2 business days. If you're remote and need VPN, note your home IP and region.
Jules: Perfect, thank you — that clears up a lot. Final Q: where to post casual stuff like lunch invites?
Sam G: #lunch-plans or #random for socials. Both ok.
Jules: Awesome, appreciate the quick tour everyone :wave:
